title: David at Nob and Gath

questions.question: Who was the priest at Nob?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 21:1 (ESV): “Then David came to Nob to Ahimelech the priest.”

questions.question: What did David ask Ahimelech for?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 21:3 (ESV): “Now then, what do you have on hand? Give me five loaves of bread...”

questions.question: What weapon did Ahimelech give David?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 21:9 (ESV): “The priest said, ‘The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you struck down... is here...’”

questions.question: Who saw David at Nob?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 21:7 (ESV): “Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day... his name was Doeg the Edomite...”

questions.question: What did David do when he fled to Achish king of Gath?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 21:13 (ESV): “So he changed his behavior before them and pretended to be insane in their hands...”

questions.question: What condition was required for David's men to eat the holy bread?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 21:4 (ESV): "...The men may eat of it if they have kept themselves from women."

questions.question: Doeg the Edomite was the chief of Saul's ______?
Why was Doeg detained before the Lord?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 21:7 (ESV): "...detained before the LORD..." (Reason implies a vow, impurity, or timing).

questions.question: Where was Goliath's sword kept?
options: Wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod
questions.correctAnswer: Wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 21:9 (ESV): "...wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod."

questions.question: How did Achish react to David's madness?
options: Do I lack madmen? Drive him away.
questions.correctAnswer: Do I lack madmen? Drive him away.
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 21:15 (ESV): "Do I lack madmen, that you have brought this fellow to behave as a madman in my presence?"

questions.question: David said, "The ______ of the young men are holy even when it is an ordinary journey."
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 21:5 (ESV): "...the vessels of the young men are holy even when it is an ordinary journey..."

questions.question: David made marks on the ______ of the gate.
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 21:13 (ESV): "...and made marks on the doors of the gate..."

questions.question: What did David let run down his beard?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 21:13 (ESV): "...and let his spittle run down his beard."

questions.question: David claimed he had an appointment with whom?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 21:2 (ESV): "David said to Ahimelech the priest, 'The king has charged me with a matter...'"

questions.question: What is the name of the bread David ate (Showbread)?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 21:6 (ESV): "So the priest gave him the holy bread, for there was no bread there but the bread of the Presence..."

key_verse_text: So the priest gave him the holy bread, for there was no bread there but the bread of the Presence... (ESV)
